name: Spotlight Wipe
description: The stage lights go down on the first clip and an oval spotlight searches across it, comes to rest and lights the second clip inside it, then widens until the lights come back up. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point where the spotlight comes to rest and opens from (0..1, y down)

params.name: size
params.description: Width of the spotlight while it searches, in frame heights

params.name: darkness
params.description: How dark the stage gets around the spotlight
